title: WhatsApp Fintech Assistant
description: A multi-agent system that integrates WhatsApp for Business with Strands agents to handle fintech operations like transaction history, payments, and daily promotions

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Integrates WhatsApp Business API with AWS End User Messaging for secure communication
Uses a multi-agent system with specialized agents for transactions, payments, and promotions
Implements secure financial transaction handling and promotional content delivery
Provides real-time response capabilities through Lambda functions
Supports asynchronous processing and comprehensive error handling
